info.description: Backend API for Telegram Mini App online shop (AlphaSales)
info.title: AlphaSales Backend API

post.description: Creates a new admin account (requires JWT)
Authenticates admin and returns JWT token
Creates a new notification for a user (admin)

get.description: Returns all orders in the system (admin)

patch.description: Updates the status of an order (admin)

post.description: Creates a new volume-based price tier (admin)

delete.description: Deletes all price tiers associated with a product (admin)
delete.summary: Delete all price tiers for a product

patch.description: Updates the minimum quantity threshold for a price tier (admin)

put.description: Adds an image URL to a product (admin)

delete.description: Removes an image URL from a product (admin)

patch.description: Updates stock quantity for a product (admin)

get.description: Returns list of all registered users (admin)

put.description: Updates quantity of product in basket

post.description: Adds a product to user's basket

get.description: Returns all items in user's basket

delete.description: Removes a product from user's basket

get.description: Returns list of all categories
Returns category details by UUID

post.description: Adds a product to user's favorites

get.description: Returns all user's favorite products

delete.description: Removes a product from user's favorites

get.description: Returns list of all firms/brands
Returns firm details by UUID

patch.description: Marks a single notification as read

get.description: Returns all notifications for a user

patch.description: Marks all notifications for a user as read

post.description: Creates a new order for a user

get.description: Returns all orders for a user
Returns order details with products
Returns all price tiers for a product
Returns price tier details by UUID
Returns list of all products
Search and filter products with pagination
Returns product details by UUID

post.description: Creates or updates a product review

get.description: Returns all reviews for a product
Returns average rating and review count for a product
Returns a specific user's review for a product
get.summary: Get user's review for a product
